searches.reason: Develop a diagnostic validity suite before adding more interventions. Search for no-op, causal-prefix, padding/readout and candidate-permutation checks, plus controlled fault injection on temporary copies of the same HSTU checkpoint. Measure whether probes detect known defects and remain quiet under equivalent inputs. This would distinguish model failures from diagnostic implementation errors without fitting additional predictors.

searches.reason: Connect observed final-item dependence to specific HSTU computations. Investigate reversible activation patching and component ablations for gates, causal aggregation, positional embeddings and the jointly trained lexical residual, checking attribution against actual target-versus-negative score changes. Use one frozen checkpoint per category and report component-intervention sensitivity without interpreting it as user intent or validation improvement.

searches.reason: Determine whether strong training-pair margins conceal failures against competitive catalog items. Investigate chunked full-catalog training-prefix ranks, repeated unique-negative sampling and error stratification by training frequency, history length and repeat versus novel targets. These diagnostics could expose sampling-dependent conclusions and identify actionable failure groups without requiring strict replacement matching, unavailable user traits or simulated feedback. Keep all results separate from pinned host validation HR@10.
